seo.title: Made to order, the privilege of a unique piece | Awrea Paris
seo.description: At Awrea Paris, each piece is made for you after you order, in your size, by French artisans. The steps, the making times and the tracking.

titre: The privilege of a unique piece.
chapeau: Each Awrea Paris creation is imagined to take shape the moment you choose it. Attentive making, carried out especially for you, where time, precision and craftsmanship make all the difference.

etapes.titre: The journey of a singular creation

frise.texte: You choose the model that suits you, along with the options offered for your piece. Your order marks the start of its making.

image.alt: A black lace dress seen from behind, its lacing in the light

frise.texte: Your order is passed on to prepare the making of your piece. Everything it needs is carefully gathered.

image.alt: Ivory lace and a pair of scissors on the atelier table

frise.texte: Your piece takes shape gesture by gesture, through the work of making. Each step is carried out with care and precision.

image.alt: A seamstress’s hands working white fabric on the atelier table

frise.titre: Exacting, down to the last detail.
frise.texte: The finishing touches are carefully completed, and the piece is closely checked before it leaves.

image.alt: A needle held between two fingers, close to white fabric

frise.texte: Your piece is prepared with care, to be shipped in its case and join its future owner.

image.alt: White bags bearing the Awrea Paris logo, ready to leave

frise.texte: Your creation finally arrives in your hands. All that remains is to discover and enjoy a piece made at your request.

image.alt: A woman in a black dress, in a dark candlelit interior

delais.texte: The making time runs from your order, before dispatch. The page of each piece shows its own.
delais.note: Cancellation, delivery and returns follow our terms and conditions of sale.

suivi.texte: Each step appears with its date in your account. Without an account, the order number and your email address are enough to follow it.

rendezVous.texte: A question of size, material or silhouette: the designer will answer you in person, by appointment.

citation.texte: This choice lies at the heart of our vision: to produce only what is desired, with awareness and respect for the environment.

ethique.texte: Making after the order gives the artisans time to do things well, and produces nothing that would end up forgotten.
